query.text: 请帮我照看老人，有危险或异常情况及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the elderly person, and notify me in time if there is any danger or abnormal situation.

annotation.text_zh: 老人摔倒了，请尽快过去查看！
annotation.text_en: The elderly person has fallen, please go check on them immediately.
The elderly person isn't up yet, we need to call the police.
